metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to running your mess with MessMate: members, meals, bazaar, expenses, deposits and closing the month.
title: Learn MessMate <accent>in 10 minutes.</accent>
subtitle: Pick your role and follow the steps. Every step tells you exactly where to tap in the app.
searchPlaceholder: Search the guide, e.g. deposit, half meal

getStarted.title: Create your account and mess
getStarted.summary: Takes two minutes. Whoever creates the mess becomes its manager.
steps: Tap Sign up and register with your email, or continue with Google.
On the next screen, give your mess a name (e.g. “Green View Mess”).
That's it: you land on the dashboard as the mess manager.
getStarted.tip: One person can be in only one mess at a time.

addMembers.title: Add your members
addMembers.summary: Invite flatmates who have an account, or create one for those who don't.
steps: Open Members and tap Invite Member.
Search by name or email, pick the person and send the invite.
They accept it from the banner on their own dashboard.
Someone without a phone or email? Tap Create Member and set up their account yourself.
addMembers.tip: Ask members to sign up first; then they appear in the search.

startMonth.title: Start the month
startMonth.summary: Every meal, bazaar, expense and deposit belongs to the active month.
steps: Open Months.
Tap Start month and give it a name, e.g. “December 2026”.
The month is now active: everything you record goes into it.

dailyMeals.title: Record daily meals
dailyMeals.summary: Pick a day and set how many meals each member had.
steps: Open Meals and choose the date (arrows or the calendar).
Use + and − for each member and meal type. Half meals (0.5) work too.
Use the “everyone” row to set a meal for all members at once.
Tap Save. You can come back and change any day of the active month.
dailyMeals.tip: Meal types (breakfast, lunch, dinner…) and their default counts can be changed on the Meals page.

approveBazaar.title: Approve bazaar
approveBazaar.summary: Members submit what they bought; only approved bazaar counts in the meal rate.
steps: New submissions show up under Pending on the Bazaar page and on your dashboard.
Check the items and total, then tap Approve, or Reject if something is wrong.
You can also add bazaar yourself from the same page.
approveBazaar.tip: A pending bazaar can still be edited or deleted; once approved it becomes a locked expense.

expenses.title: Add bills and other expenses
expenses.summary: Shared bills are split between members; individual ones go to one person.
steps: Open Expenses and enter a title and amount, e.g. “Gas bill 1,000”.
Choose Shared for bills everyone pays (gas, internet, maid) and select who shares it.
Choose Individual for something only one member owes.
Pick the date and save.

deposits.title: Record deposits
deposits.summary: Every taka a member gives to the mess fund.
steps: Open Deposits.
Pick the member, enter the amount and date.
Save. Their balance updates straight away.

fixMistakes.title: Fix a mistake
fixMistakes.summary: Entered a wrong amount or date? Edit or delete it any time before the month closes.
steps: Open Reports and go to the Expenses or Deposits tab.
Tap the pencil on the row to change title, amount or date, or delete it.
Meals: just open that day on the Meals page and save again.
Bazaar: edit or delete it while it is still pending.
fixMistakes.tip: A closed month can't be changed, so check the numbers before closing.

closeMonth.title: Close the month
closeMonth.summary: Freezes the month's accounts and starts the next one with balances carried over.
steps: Open Months and tap Close & start new.
Review everyone's final balance.
Choose whether balances carry forward; you can leave out individual members.
Check the new month's name and confirm. The old month is archived with its full summary.
closeMonth.tip: Extra money becomes next month's deposit; dues become next month's expense.

manageMess.title: Managers and mess settings
manageMess.summary: Share the work with a second manager and keep the member list tidy.
steps: Mess Settings → Managers: hand over your role, add a co-manager (at most 2 per mess) or step down.
Members → Remove takes someone out of the mess; their past months stay in the records.
Mess Settings lets you change the mess name and description.

joinMess.title: Join your mess
joinMess.summary: Your manager adds you; you just accept.
steps: Sign up with your email (or Google).
Tell your manager the email you used so they can invite you.
When the invite arrives, tap Accept on your dashboard.
joinMess.tip: No phone or email? Your manager can create your account for you.

myBalance.title: See your meals, bill and balance
myBalance.summary: No calculating: your numbers are always up to date.
steps: Your dashboard shows your balance, deposits and bill breakdown.
Tap “Everyone's summary” to see every member's balance.
Reports shows the month's meals, expenses, deposits and bazaar day by day.
The bell shows what changed in the mess since you last looked.
myBalance.tip: Positive balance = the mess owes you; negative = you owe the mess.

submitBazaar.title: Submit your bazaar
submitBazaar.summary: Did the shopping? Add it so it counts in the meal rate.
steps: Open Bazaar and add each item with its price.
Pick the date you shopped and submit.
Your manager approves it. Until then you can still edit or delete it.

installApp.title: Install the app on your phone
installApp.summary: Opens full screen from your home screen, like a normal app.
steps: Open the Install guide.
Follow the steps for your phone and browser.
Open MessMate from the new icon on your home screen.

math.title: How the numbers are calculated
math.rate: Meal rate = total approved bazaar ÷ total meals
math.bill: Bill = your meals × meal rate + your share of shared bills + your individual expenses
math.balance: Balance = your deposits − your bill (+ anything carried from last month)

rateChanges.q: Why does the meal rate keep changing?
rateChanges.a: It is total bazaar divided by total meals so far, so every new bazaar or meal moves it. The final rate is fixed when the month closes.

pending.q: Why doesn't my bazaar show in the meal rate?
pending.a: Only approved bazaar counts. Ask your manager to approve it from the Bazaar page.

lateMonth.q: We started using MessMate in the middle of the month. Is that a problem?
lateMonth.a: No. In your first month you can add meals, bazaar and expenses for earlier dates too.

removed.q: What happens when a member leaves?
removed.a: Settle their balance, then remove them from Members. Their past months stay in the records.

twoManagers.q: Can two people manage the mess?
twoManagers.a: Yes, up to two managers with the same permissions.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.body: Create your mess now; it takes about five minutes.
